basic_details.job_title: COEP Technological University Pune Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Research Associate/ Junior Research Fellow Posts

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. in Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation Engineering, M.E./M.Tech/M.S. with 3 years experience, M.Sc. in Physics/Electronics, B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation
qualification.details: Research Associate (01/RA-1): Ph.D. completed/nearing completion in Electrical/Electrical and Electronics/Instrumentation/Electronics engineering with quality publications OR 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after Master's degree (M.E./MTech/M.S.) in Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation engineering with at least one research paper in SCI journal. Preference for valid GATE score. Junior Research Fellow (02/JRF-1): M.Sc. in Physics/Electronics OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech) in Electrical/Electronic/Instrumentation/Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering and equivalent. Candidate with relevant experience in DC-DC converters, power electronics and embedded systems.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 58000/- + 30% HRA (Research Associate), Rs. 37000/- + 30% HRA (Junior Research Fellow)
salary_details.details: Research Associate: Rs. 58000/- + 30% HRA Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 37000/- + 30% HRA

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the COEP Technological University Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your offline application for the COEP Technological University Pune Recruitment 2026 is 20th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by COEP Technological University Pune for the positions of Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate position, candidates need to have a Ph.D. in Electrical/Electrical and Electronics/Instrumentation/Electronics engineering with publications, or 3 years of research experience after a Master's degree with a research paper in an SCI journal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position offers a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month, plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by COEP Technological University Pune.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application process for the COEP Technological University Pune Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection criteria for the advertised positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow posts will primarily involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of COEP Technological University Pune, which is www.coeptech.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow at COEP Technological University Pune are contractual in nature.

faq.answer: The provided data does not explicitly detail age relaxation. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for specific information on age limits and any applicable relaxations.
